english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a young person or someone who looks youthful.

exampleSentences.english: That young guy is full of energy.
exampleSentences.jyutping: go2 go3 hau6 saang1 zai2 hou2 jau5 wut6 lik6

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone who is younger.

exampleSentences.english: The junior members of our team are still inexperienced.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋隊入面啲後生仔仲未熟手。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 deoi6 jap6 min6 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2 zung6 mei6 suk6 sau2

english.note: Use this colloquial choice especially when saying that a person is young or looks young.

exampleSentences.english: You look so youthful that no one would believe you have a son.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你個樣咁後生，話你有個仔真係冇人信。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 go3 joeng2 gam3 hau6 saang1 waa6 nei5 jau5 go3 zai2 zan1 hai6 mou5 jan4 seon3
